[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Mary was born in 1682. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-2682|James Glasgow]] and [[Duff-5042|Isobell Duff]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2682]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Mary's 23 April 1682 Edinburgh index names James Glasgow and Issobell Duffe. The full James/Issobell Duffe couple recurs in the same Edinburgh household and exact child sequence.

Confident for the recorded daughter and father, without settling the father’s other proposed identities.
